title: FOMO Concerts presents: DECIPHER | AKEDIA | WOVENTONGVE
body:
Black Metal on a Sunday you say? Well, we’re in! The next day is a holiday, so don’t skip this! DECIPHER | black metal | Greece
Decipher is a black metal band from Athens, formed in 2017. After touring extensively across Europe they released their second full-length album, “ΘΕΛΗΜΑ” (Thelema), in March through Transcending Obscurity Records.“Thelema demonstrates that Decipher’s command of rhythm, melody, and grit has only gotten better, as it compels with the joint force of hookiness and evil. Using recurring patterns of riff, vocals, and percussion that each cue one another, Decipher create a thrashing feeling of push-and-pull that’s downright magnetic.” (angrymetalguy)
https://decipherbm.bandcamp.com/
AKEDIA | sludge punk | Innsbruck
AkediA from Innsbruck are mixing up sludge, doom, stoner and punk. An alpine two-piece that certainly delivers.
https://666akedia.bandcamp.com
WOVENTONGVE | black metal | Wien
WOVENTONGVE is an entity from Vienna that delivers black metal with a clear artistic vision: melding coarse riffing, eerie melodies and haunting clean-sung invocations into a raw yet strikingly multi-layered sound. Music for night-foundered vicambulists and walkers in the dark.
https://woventongve.bandcamp.com/
25.10.2026 | Venster99 | Wien
(Next day Feiertag)
Eintritt & Bar: freie SpendeNoise is for everyone. Except assholes.
